why: Owner (2026-10-14): Zugrio must be profitable beyond Deriv synthetics - crypto, commodities, indices, forex. C_crypto_trend.data: Binance spot daily closes, BTCUSDT and ETHUSDT, from listing (2017-08) to 2026-10 (data-api.binance.vision)

rules.C1_tsmom12: each month end: position = sign(12-month return); hold one month (as round 4 rule A)
rules.C2_weekly4: each week end (Sunday close): position = sign(4-week return); hold one week (crypto short-horizon momentum, Liu-Tsyvinski 2021)
rules.C3_long_only_trend: each week end: long if close > its 20-week average, else flat

C_crypto_trend.unit: R = position x next-period return / trailing 60-day daily volatility x sqrt(period days)
C_crypto_trend.costs: 0.2% of price per position change (CFD spread) plus financing on |position| at 0%, 10% and 20% a year (crypto CFD swaps are often 10-20%/yr; the broker's actual swap decides)
C_crypto_trend.pass: pooled BTC+ETH mean R > 0 in BOTH samples and pooled t >= 2, at 10%/yr financing (3 rules)

I_index_turn_of_month.data: HistData 1-minute bars aggregated to daily closes (UTC 21:00 cut), SPXUSD, NSXUSD, GRXEUR, UKXGBP, JPXJPY, 2010-01 to 2026-09
I_index_turn_of_month.rule: long from the close of the 2nd-last trading day of each month to the close of the 3rd trading day of the next month (Lakonishok-Smidt 1988; Ariel 1987); flat otherwise
I_index_turn_of_month.control: the same number of days held at random other times of the month (mean daily return outside the window)
I_index_turn_of_month.costs: 0.02% of price per round trip (index CFD spread) plus 5%/yr financing for the days held
I_index_turn_of_month.pass: pooled over the 5 indices: window mean daily return minus outside-window mean daily return > 0 with t >= 2 in BOTH samples, and the net window trade positive in both

unchanged: No rule, window or cost is changed after a result; anything else is a new registration.
